conventions: Frequency factor 0.96 is already applied; do not scale twice.
Retain largest 3N-6 frequencies; omitted six translational/rotational residues are recorded and checked below 2 cm^-1.
Electronic energies plus retained-mode ZPE define only relative energies among same-N records. No absolute atomization energy is adopted.
One electronic component and one geometric entry per record, source rotational symmetry; no extra spin or chiral multiplicity.
Declared mass 32.065 u per atom and 1 bar; this is not an exact execution of the original ASE 3.8.1 code.
